description: This file is a shell script library that provides functions for starting and stopping a git daemon for testing purposes. It includes setup routines, prerequisite checks, and a simplified netcat-like client, all tailored to facilitate testing in a Git environment.

methods.name: start_git_daemon
methods.description: Function to start a git daemon with specified configurations, handle its process ID, and ensure readiness before proceeding.

methods.name: stop_git_daemon
methods.description: Function to stop the running git daemon process, clean up temporary files, and handle process termination.

methods.name: fake_nc
methods.description: A minimal netcat-like function implemented in Perl that connects to specified host:port, sends stdin, and outputs the response to stdout.
